request.query: Register EU citizen's right of residence (EU registration with Migri)

sources.title: enterfinland.fi
highlights: You must apply for registration of your right of residence in Finland if you reside in Finland for over 3 months and are a citizen of an EU Member State, Liechtenstein or Switzerland
Visit a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service to prove your identity within 3 months of arriving in Finland

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: If you apply for EU registration on the basis of studies, your right of residence can be registered only after your studies have started
You have a valid passport or identity card
originals and copies of the documents that you attach to your application
Book an appointment in our appointment system (migri.vihta.com) to visit a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service
If you meet the requirements for registration and have presented the necessary attachments, you can get a registration certificate immediately when you visit a service point to prove your identity

sources.title: finlandhandbook.com
highlights: Sometimes, new slots appear for a fleeting moment due to cancellations or system updates
Expand Your Search: If you absolutely cannot find a slot in your preferred city, consider if you can travel to another service point

sources.title: finlandhandbook.com
highlights: Remember to book this appointment as soon as you submit your online application, because appointment slots, especially in busy periods, can fill up fast
